encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

div.note: Athenaeus 7, 311 d ὡς διαφόρου ὄντος τοῦ τῶν λαβράκων ἐγκεφάλου, καθάπερ καὶ τοῦ τῶν γλαύκων. καὶ Εὔβουλος δ' ἐν Τιτθαῖς φησι κτλ.

1. καθαρίως A. ἂν ᾖ Casaub. conl. Ephipp. 15] ἐανη A. 2. σηπίδια A. 3. μικρὰ Schweigh.] τὰ μικρὰ A. πουλύποδος Dindf.] πολυποδος A. 4. χόρια, πυόν Casaub.] χοριαπυον A. imitatus est, si quidem imitatus est, Ephippus Ὁμοίοις fr. 15, 3. 4. cf. etiam Nicostr. (Philet.) 6, 2. Amphid. 35. καθαρείως est honeste et modeste. Strab. 3, 154 καθαρείως καὶ λιτῶς. τευθίδιον a τευθίς, τευθίδος Athen. 3, 106 c contra comicorum consuetudinem, apud quos semper τευθίδες et τευθίδια (Pherecr. 130, 10. Ephipp. 15, 4). ac fortasse Eubulus ex Ephippo emendandus καθαρείως· ὅ τι ἂν ᾖ, ὁσίας ἕνεκ' ἀρκεῖ. τευθίδια, σηπίδια.
Εὔβουλος Τιτθαῖς (τηθαῖς A). Athenaeus 3, 106 a. in poetae verbis nihil varietatis habet A.
